## Objective
- Finish and validate the existing 3D Crown Rush game, fixing confirmed gameplay blockers rather than replacing the implementation.
- Validate hazards, checkpoints, fall/respawn, finish, and replay in-browser.

## Requirements
- Test the existing game in-browser and address confirmed issues as they’re confirmed.

## Decisions
- Continue testing the existing implementation and use observed gameplay to guide fixes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed ArrowUp so it moves forward without also jumping; queued controls clear on race reset and browser blur.
- Added and linked `public/favicon.svg`.
- Confirmed the lobby renders and the countdown transitions to `RACING`.
- Changed spinner collision so airborne runners are not hit by the sweeper arm.
- Rebuilt after the spinner change; `npm run build` succeeded and `git diff --check` passed.
- Earlier browser testing reached all three checkpoints and traversed the tile bridge.

### Active
- Resolve the finish-area stall: the race can remain `RACING` at `100%` progress without showing the finish screen.
- Recent scripted browser testing also showed repeated hazard knockbacks and a return to checkpoint 1; continue validating fall/respawn, finish, and replay.
- Remove temporary `window.__player` and `window.__game` debug exports from `src/main.js` after investigation.

### Blocked
- Finish and replay validation remain blocked until the player reliably reaches and triggers the finish.

## Next Move
1. Inspect final-climb movement and finish logic in `src/main.js`, especially `groundAt`, `surfaceAt`, `stepRunner`, foam-wall collisions, and the finish condition.
2. Reproduce the end-course stall and fix the confirmed cause; account for hazard knockbacks observed in the latest browser run.
3. Remove temporary debug exports, rebuild, and run `git diff --check`.
4. Browser-test finish and replay, then exercise fall/respawn.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: course geometry, movement, hazards, checkpoints, respawn, finish logic, and temporary debug exports.
- `index.html`: lobby, HUD, touch controls, finish screen, and favicon link.
- `public/favicon.svg`: added game favicon.
- `dist/`: tracked generated build output, updated by the latest build.
- `/tmp/opencode/cdp-race.mjs`: temporary CDP script for scripted browser gameplay and HUD/state checks.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A browser run with forward input and repeated jumps reached `100%` progress but remained `RACING` for at least 110 seconds without showing the finish screen.
- The latest instrumented run lasted 70 seconds, reached about `33.6%`, and showed repeated knockbacks/backtracking around hazards and checkpoint 1.
- `src/main.js` currently exposes the player and game objects as `window.__player` and `window.__game` for temporary browser diagnosis.
- The production build warns that the JavaScript bundle is `520.62 kB`, above Vite’s `500 kB` warning threshold.

## Objective
- Finish and validate the existing 3D Crown Rush game, fixing confirmed gameplay blockers rather than replacing the implementation.
- Continue testing the existing game in-browser, including hazards, checkpoints, fall/respawn, finish, and replay.

## Requirements
- Test the existing game in-browser and address confirmed issues as they’re confirmed.

## Decisions
- Broadened the finish trigger’s horizontal range to match the course width after identifying the old `Math.abs(e.x)<4` check as a likely cause of the finish stall.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed ArrowUp so it moves forward without also jumping; queued controls clear on race reset and browser blur.
- Added and linked `public/favicon.svg`.
- Confirmed lobby rendering and countdown-to-racing transition.
- Changed spinner collision so airborne runners are not hit by the sweeper arm.
- Browser-tested finish at `x=8`, replay reset/start, and checkpoint-2 fall/respawn using controlled player state.
- Removed temporary `window.__player` and `window.__game` exports.
- `npm run build` succeeded and `git diff --check` passed before the latest finish-range adjustment.

### Active
- Rebuild and rerun `git diff --check` after the latest finish-trigger change to `<10.5`.
- Validate the widened finish trigger through normal gameplay and continue testing hazards and checkpoints.

### Blocked
- Full organic race-to-finish validation remains unconfirmed; scripted play has shown repeated hazard knockbacks and backtracking.

## Next Move
1. Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check` after the latest source change.
2. Browser-test natural approach to the finish, then confirm finish screen and replay.
3. Continue validating hazard traversal and fall/respawn under normal play.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: course, movement, hazards, checkpoints, respawn, finish trigger, and replay logic.
- `index.html`: game UI and favicon link.
- `public/favicon.svg`: added favicon.
- `dist/`: tracked generated build output; rebuild after the final source change.
- `/tmp/opencode/verify-race.mjs`: controlled browser verification script; depends on debug exports that have since been removed.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The latest finish condition is `e.z<-196 && Math.abs(e.x)<10.5 && e.y>7.5`; the last successful build preceded this final adjustment.
- The production build warns that the JavaScript bundle is `520.62 kB`, above Vite’s `500 kB` warning threshold.

## Objective
- Finish and validate the existing 3D Crown Rush game, fixing confirmed gameplay blockers rather than replacing the implementation.
- Continue testing the existing game in-browser, including hazards, checkpoints, fall/respawn, finish, and replay.

## Requirements
- Test the existing game in-browser and address confirmed issues as they’re confirmed.

## Decisions
- Broadened the finish trigger’s horizontal range to match the course width, changing the player check to `Math.abs(e.x)<10.5`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed ArrowUp so it moves forward without also jumping; queued controls clear on race reset and browser blur.
- Added and linked `public/favicon.svg`.
- Confirmed lobby rendering and countdown-to-racing transition.
- Changed spinner collision so airborne runners are not hit by the sweeper arm.
- Browser-tested finish at `x=8`, replay reset/start, and checkpoint-2 fall/respawn using controlled player state.
- Removed temporary `window.__player` and `window.__game` exports.
- `npm run build` succeeded after the finish-trigger change; `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Continue browser testing hazards, checkpoints, fall/respawn, natural finish approach, and replay.
- Latest organic attempt held forward and tapped jump periodically; progress reached only about 16% before the test command timed out, so finish remains unconfirmed through natural play.

### Blocked
- Full organic race-to-finish validation remains unconfirmed; prior attempts showed hazard knockbacks/backtracking, and the latest browser script timed out.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser testing with a more reliable control sequence and confirm natural finish and replay.
2. Investigate slow or stalled progress during forward movement and continue validating hazard traversal and respawn.
3. Rebuild and run `git diff --check` after any further source edits.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: movement, hazards, checkpoints, respawn, finish trigger, and replay logic.
- `index.html`: game UI and favicon link.
- `public/favicon.svg`: added favicon.
- `dist/`: tracked generated build output; updated by the latest build.
- `/tmp/opencode/natural-race.mjs`: latest browser test script; timed out during organic play.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Latest build warns that the JavaScript bundle is `520.62 kB`, above Vite’s `500 kB` warning threshold.
- The latest organic browser attempt did not finish; progress reached roughly `16.4%` before timeout.
